scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix web/server && npm ci --prefix web/client && npm ci --prefix desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop-runtime.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && npm run dist:win --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop-runtime.mjs --platform darwin --arch x64 && npm run dist:mac:x64 --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop-runtime.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && npm run dist:mac:arm64 --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:linux:x64: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop-runtime.mjs --platform linux --arch x64 && npm run dist:linux:x64 --prefix desktop
